title: On Kernel Eigen-alignments of KRR: Reconstruction and Generalization
abstract: arXiv:2605.15240v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: This paper investigates the critical role of eigenalignments between the kernel matrix and learning targets in achieving robust generalization in learning problems. We establish a direct connection between generalization performance in kernel methods and the estimation of eigenvectors and eigenvalues of matrices, offering a more intuitive understanding compared to prior work with minimal assumptions. We also show that, since the prediction task in KRR is essentially the weighted sum of eigenvectors/singular vectors, by analyzing how much error can be caused by perturbations to the kernel matrix, we can then derive a bound on this generalization error using the estimation stability of matrix eigenvalues and eigenvectors. Compared with previous work, our analysis concentrates on finite-sample settings and on the generalization error arising from having a suboptimal finite training set. tldr: 本文建立了核岭回归泛化性能与核矩阵特征值、特征向量估计稳定性之间的直接联系，通过特征对齐分析在有限样本设定下推导出泛化误差的界。
en_tdlr: This paper establishes a direct connection between generalization performance in kernel ridge regression and the estimation stability of the kernel matrix's eigenvalues and eigenvectors, deriving bounds on finite-sample generalization error through eigenalignment analysis.
